# PowerPlay v2.0.0 — Fire TV

## Changes in this release

- Full PowerPlay visual rebrand with equilateral right-facing play glyph, crisp white P, cyan lightning bolt, and electric blue/purple color family.
- New launcher, Android adaptive icon, theme-friendly transparent splash, Fire TV banners, Home Assistant and README artwork.
- Replaced original Plezy icon imagery across 23 selectable icon styles without changing users' stored icon IDs.
- Updated display names and localized UI strings from Plezy to PowerPlay while preserving proper upstream license and source attribution.
- Coordinated appearance with PowerLink 1.0.0 and updated brand assets and guidelines.

## Compatibility

- Android app ID remains `com.power.powerplay`, with existing `powerplay://` intents and PowerLink/PowerShuffle protocol unchanged.
- Playback, queue transfer, signing, and settings storage remain unchanged by design.
- This is an unpublished release candidate; visual and hardware verification is required before any public release.
